world_frame: origin on the floor at the centre of the door opening, on the machine's front face; +X into the machine, +Y to the operator's left, +Z up

cart.note: Mobile cart carrying the robot and the blank rack, so the cell rolls away from the machine as one unit. The robot-to-rack geometry is fixed on the cart; only the cart-to-machine position depends on docking.
cart.frame: origin on the floor under the centre of the cart's front edge (the edge that docks to the machine); axes parallel to the world frame, so the cart occupies x in [-depth, 0]

docked_position.note: world XY of the cart origin when docked: front edge 20 mm clear of the machine front wall; 40 mm to the operator's right so the tall legs clear the tray left of the door (it starts at y=+300, 780-940 mm up)

deck_top_height.note: top of the steel deck above the floor, with casters on the floor and leveling feet down; high enough that the robot on a short riser reaches down onto the vise on the machine table (flange 1250 mm: 1200 cannot reach the vise, 1300 lets the elbow hit the wall above the door)

cart.handle_note: push bar on the back legs (the deck is too high to push from)

dock.note: floor-mounted docking block at the machine; two tapered pins on the cart front locate into it

xy.note: flange centre on the cart, cart frame (on the door centreline when docked); as far forward as the riser allows

rack_origin_xy.note: slot 0 base centre, cart frame; the rack plate sits on the deck (slot base 1150 mm, reachable band about 1000-1250 mm)

offset_from_table_center.note: vise mounted 60 mm toward the door from the table centre (overhangs the 318 mm table front edge by ~76 mm) to bring it within the robot's reach

vise_on_table.clamp_axis: world X (fixed jaw toward the back of the machine)

rack.location: on the cart deck at cart.rack_origin_xy
rack.blank_orientation: standing, thickness along world X, width along world Y (same as in the vise)
rack.note: Slot k base is at origin + (k * pitch, 0, 0). Each slot holds one blank; left/right jaws use adjacent slots.

clearances.note: door_transit is in the world frame (it belongs to the door); home is cart.home_tcp and moves with the cart. Docked, home keeps every robot link at x < -50 (outside the front wall); both points were chosen from a reachability sweep
